routes.title: Songthaew Routes
routes.selectRoute: Select a route to view on map

circular.name: Circular Route
circular.description: The most popular route. Runs south along Beach Road, loops at Walking Street, then returns north along Second Road.
circular.priceNote: Fixed 10 THB anywhere along the route

northPattaya.name: North Pattaya Road
northPattaya.description: Runs east-west along North Pattaya Road between the Dolphin Roundabout and Sukhumvit Road.
northPattaya.priceNote: Fixed 10 THB for the standard route

centralPattaya.name: Central Pattaya Road
centralPattaya.description: Runs east-west along Central Pattaya Road, connecting Sukhumvit Road to Second Road and Beach Road.
centralPattaya.priceNote: Fixed 10 THB for the standard route

southPattaya.name: South Pattaya Road
southPattaya.description: Runs along South Pattaya Road from Sukhumvit intersection toward Walking Street area.
southPattaya.priceNote: Fixed 10 THB for the standard route

naKluea.name: Naklua Route
naKluea.description: Runs from Dolphin Roundabout north to Naklua area, passing Wongamat Beach and Sanctuary of Truth.

soiBuakhao.name: Soi Buakhao Route
soiBuakhao.description: Runs along Soi Buakhao from South Pattaya northward, a popular route through the central entertainment area.
soiBuakhao.priceNote: Fixed 10 THB for the standard route

thirdRoad.name: Third Road Route
thirdRoad.description: Runs along Third Road (Pattaya Sai 3), connecting South Pattaya to the northern areas via the inland road.
thirdRoad.priceNote: Fixed 10 THB for the standard route

jomtien.name: Jomtien Route
jomtien.description: Connects South Pattaya (Walking Street area) to Jomtien Beach. Great for beach-goers.

thepprasit.name: Thepprasit Route
thepprasit.description: Runs along Thepprasit Road from Sukhumvit to the night market area. Operates Fri-Sun evenings only.
thepprasit.priceNote: Fixed 10 THB for the standard route

tips.pressButton: Press the buzzer/bell button when approaching your stop
tips.haveChange: Have small bills ready (20 THB notes ideal)
tips.payWhenExit: Pay the driver when you get off, not when boarding
tips.waveToStop: Wave your hand to flag down a passing songthaew
tips.checkDirection: Make sure the songthaew is heading in your direction
tips.nightPrice: Late night rides may cost more (after 10 PM)
tips.charterPrice: If you're the only passenger, the driver may try to charter - negotiate the price
tips.beachRoadSouth: On Beach Road, songthaews only go south (toward Walking Street)
tips.secondRoadNorth: On Second Road, songthaews only go north (toward Dolphin Roundabout)

about.title: About Ten Baht Ride
about.whatIsDesc: A songthaew (สองแถว, literally "two rows") is a converted pickup truck with two bench seats in the back. It's the most common and affordable public transport in Pattaya, with fixed routes costing just 10 Thai Baht (≈ $0.30 USD).
howToRideSteps: Stand on the roadside and wave to flag down a songthaew going your direction
Hop on the back - no need to tell the driver your stop
When approaching your destination, press the buzzer button inside
After getting off, walk to the driver's window and pay 10 Baht
That's it! No tickets, no apps, just hop on and off
about.disclaimer: Route and price information is provided as a reference guide. Actual routes and fares may vary.
